breed.appearance: A medium-sized, sturdy torbie (tortoiseshell-tabby) cat with a brindled coat of warm brown, ginger-orange, and black patches mottled together, brightest orange across the shoulders and lower back with a dark black-brown streak running down the spine and a mostly black tail. breed.fun_fact: Torbie cats like Piper combine tortoiseshell colors with tabby stripes, so every one wears a one-of-a-kind coat, and they're famous for their spunky, 'tortitude'-filled personalities!
